Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
Urinalysis shows significant leukocyturia, bacteriuria, nitrites, and positive urine culture for >100,000 CFU/mL E. coli, consistent with a urinary tract infection. Hematuria and mild proteinuria are present. Glucosuria with normal ketones may suggest hyperglycemia. Low specific gravity could indicate dilute urine. Recommend clinical correlation and consideration of diabetes screening and appropriate antibiotic therapy.
